qwen3-embedding:0.6b.query_prefix:
Instruct: Given a question, retrieve the memory notes that answer it
Query:

gate.measure: recall at 5 per question: the share of its answer items among the method's first five
gate.baseline: hybrid (BM25 fused with LSA by reciprocal rank): the best search without a model
gate.choose_on_dev: only dev results made under this manifest, the first per candidate, every candidate measured; a (model, method) with method embed or hybrid_embed qualifies when its dev recall on direct and on persian questions is not below hybrid's and its median query time is at most 1000 ms; of those, the highest dev recall on reworded questions, then on persian; a tie goes to the smaller download, then to embed (one retriever). No qualifier: keywords stay, and the sealed set stays unread.
gate.sealed_once: the chosen (model, method) and hybrid on the 30 sealed questions, read once: a marker is written before the file is opened, so a crashed run is not repeated
gate.enter: embeddings enter only if all four hold on the sealed set, each a paired difference chosen minus hybrid per question: (1) reworded (10 questions): mean at least 0.30 and the 90% bootstrap interval's lower end above 0 (2,000 draws over questions, seed 35); (2) direct (10): mean not below 0; (3) persian (10): mean not below 0; (4) the median query time at most 1000 ms. Otherwise keywords stay, and the result is reported as it is. Persian recall is reported with its interval beside the verdict.
gate.limit: one invented corpus of 116 items and 66 questions; 10 sealed questions a group move a group's recall by 0.1 each; latency and memory are this machine's (an 8 GB MacBook Air) and change with load

objective: Before any vector store: does a local embedding model find an agent's memory items better than search without a model when the question uses other words or is asked in Persian, without losing the direct questions?
